remarks: RARE in ClockTower- True 2-bedroom End Unit that offers one of the best layouts in the complex. A large useful space that has separate living, dining and office areas.You will be impressed from the moment you walk into this pristine one level unit (no stairs) with an open concept floor plan that offers loads of natural light. Featuring soaring windows with 13.5' ceilings, private bedroom with custom built-ins in the closet and hallway closet, updated full bath with Kohler and Moen fixtures and marble vanity. Kitchen offers newer stainless steel appliances, garbage disposal and opens to the dining area, living room and separate office area. The Clocktower Close is a historic building that has been renovated to provide fabulous living space and community areas throughout the premises, including an outdoor courtyard, a full gym and a full locker room w/sauna, a business meeting room, a full community kitchen, a billiards room and a dog run. Easy access to highways, train station and public transportation. Minutes to shopping, new SoNo mall, restaurants, parks and to the beach.
